asset_rebuild_note: sop-embeddings-v1.2.0 (2026-09-23): built by shared-utils/sop-embed-once/build-and-publish.sh on the OPERATOR's Gemini key against sops-library-v3.jsonl.gz (release sop-library-v3.0.0, sha256-verified against SOP-LIBRARY-MANIFEST.json). Two tables: sop_embeddings (sop_count=2700 distinct asset ids, keyed "sop_" + slug.replace("-","_")[:60]: 2555 V2 ids + 145 department SOPs; boxes key sops on sop_ + sha256(slug) (U078) and provision_sop_embeddings.py maps each row through that slug rule) and role_library_embeddings (role_library_count=640: one vector per role-folder slug `role-library:<dept>/<role>` a box build uses, from role_library_vectors.py -- the CC's importRoleLibrary() rows carry no per-box vector, CC #416).
